associationCommitted.description: completed association settles queue without replay

associationReserved.description: reserved association becomes unknown after cognition commit

claimsCommitted.description: completed cognition is linked and only unreserved association resumes

modelReserved.description: reserved cognition becomes unknown and queue does not replay

processingIntentCommitted.description: committed queue insert remains queued after restart

processingIntentReserved.description: unreserved model stage is safely queued after restart

processingIntentUncommitted.description: uncommitted queue insert rolls back without leaving an intent

scope: local synthetic ports, SIGKILL and resumed/replayed fixtures; no cloud calls or reminders
